<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum shows peaks at 167.15 (likely carbonyl), 143.85 and 130.30 (aromatic/sp2), 34.53 (appears twice), and three peaks in the typical methyl region: 22.80, 21.35, 19.20 ppm. These three low‑field signals correspond to three distinct CH₃ groups. The two identical peaks at 34.53 ppm are more downfield than usual methyl carbons and are likely quaternary or methylene carbons rather than methyls. Therefore, the molecule contains three methyl (CH₃) groups.</thought>
<final_answer>3</final_answer>
